page.overview:
What is Burntrap?

is the tertiary antagonist of Five Nights at Freddy's: Security Breach. He is an animatronic of enigmatic origin who resided in the underground ruins of Freddy Fazbear's Pizza Place, appearing in the base game's "Burn It All Down" Ending.

Burntrap has a physical appearance that resembles both of William Afton's depictions in Five Nights at Freddy's 3 and Freddy Fazbear's Pizzeria Simulator, though with significant differences. His suit is olive and dark yellow in color, with an exposed human jawbone with teeth. His endoskeleton resembles a combination of the Glamrock Animatronics and a Springlock endoskeleton, with some parts of human bone with sharp claws at the tip of each digit with five fingers instead of four, matching the mysterious hand at the end of the February 2021 trailer. His costume is remarkably smooth and appears to have an oily, flesh like texture. The suit has missing segments of its costume, such as on his limbs and pelvis area. His eyes are pitch black with purple glowing pupils. His right foot's endoskeleton is completely exposed, while his left foot still has its costume covering.

Burntrap displays little to no personality, as he doesn't outwardly express any emotion besides sinisterly laughing with sadistic joy. He also appears to be incapable of speech, as he doesn't speak during his encounter with Gregory. However, Burntrap is implied to be persistent as he continues to try and possess Glamrock Freddy during the ending's boss battle even after Gregory repeatedly burns him with the incinerators located in his chambers.
